payload.title: Apply motion trails and echo smear
payload.description:
## Behavior
As an author, I can add trails that follow object motion without manually animating every copy.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given a trajectory, when sampled in any frame order or worker partition, then the trail matches sequential playback. Document precomputation, supported targets, memory limits, and how parameter edits invalidate cached trajectories.

## Ownership
stdlib, toolchain, player

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
